title: Typing a space at the end of a step drops the focus
why: Coach Milan 23 November 2026, 19:03, after making a recipe (Lazy Burek): in the recipe's steps, a space typed at the end of a step's text drops the focus from the field; typing only works right after the last word. 21:31: finish the steps part. Not reproduced in the browser here; 21:33: Samsung Keyboard. Proposed: no saving while the keyboard builds a word, one save when it is in, the page not drawn again on every key. 21:34: draw.

opportunity.from: Coach Milan's own recipe, Lazy Burek, 23 November 2026.
opportunity.job: Write a step the way I type: words, spaces, more words.
opportunity.kind: Too many steps: the cursor jumps out after a space; typing works only right after the last word.
opportunity.why_now: Most testers write on Android phones; Samsung Keyboard is common there.

story: When I add words at the end of a step, I want the cursor to stay where I type, so that I can finish the step in one go.
proposed: 1. While the phone's keyboard is building a word (composition), the step field does not save. 2. When the word is in, the field saves once. 3. Saving a step no longer draws the whole recipe page again on every key; only the ticks on the food buttons follow. Nothing changes on screen.
problem: The step field saves on every key, and each save draws the recipe page again. Samsung Keyboard builds each word in a draft and puts it in at the space; a page drawn again while the draft is open loses the cursor.
checks: Light: Edit recipe's steps and the publish sheet's steps. The unit tests; the build; a new walkthrough that types with a phone keyboard's composition (AC1 to AC3); and steps-and-parts, steps-own-amounts and recipe-after, about 5 minutes. No new words. Then Coach Milan types on his own phone, with Samsung Keyboard, once he has it on Preview.
decision: Samsung Keyboard 21:33, draw 21:34. Drawn 23 November 2026 for Coach Milan's look. No Go, so nothing is built.
now: Edit recipe, step 2 of Lazy Burek ends with 375 g Frischer Blätterteig. With Samsung Keyboard, a space at the end drops the cursor out of the field. In the browser here it does not happen.
looked_at: A plain text box per step: not chosen; the food chips with their amounts live inside the step.

ac.title: A space at the end
ac.text: Given step 2 in Edit recipe, when I type a space and a word at its end with a phone keyboard that builds words, then the cursor stays in step 2 and the step holds the new word

ac.title: Saved when the word is in
ac.text: Given a word being built by the keyboard, when it is in, then the step is saved once, with the word, and Save changes keeps it

ac.title: The food buttons follow
ac.text: Given a food put into a step, when I type after it, then its button keeps its tick and nothing else on the page moves

unchanged: A tap on a food puts it where the cursor is.
+ Step here and + Add a step.
details: Composition: compositionstart to compositionend; the field reads its text at compositionend and on any input outside a composition.
Not reproduced in Chromium on a phone-sized screen; the walkthrough emulates a keyboard's composition with the browser's own input commands. The real check is Coach Milan's phone.
The pictures are the same screen of main, 0.3.189: the change is not visible.
short: A space at the end of a step keeps the cursor, with Samsung Keyboard
rel: Proposed; not agreed until Coach Milan says Go
